comment: Optional tool-side authoring aid (SPEC-PLATED-001 Section 7). Provides autofill defaults for known models and drift warnings (V-07). NOT a source of truth: the emulator reads identity from the manifest, not from this file. Keyed model -> identity; identity is NOT a key. cypress_isa and cypress_ide deliberately share 0x1080:0xc693 (one multifunction 82C693 part, func0 ISA bridge vs func1 IDE, distinguished by class_code) -- this is correct, not a duplicate-identity error, so there is no duplicate vendor/device guard.

pci_models.comment: Cypress 82C693 ISA bridge, func0. Shares 0x1080:0xc693 with cypress_ide (same multifunction part, func0 vs func1). Fixed legacy south bridge; no relocatable BARs.
Cypress 82C693 IDE func1. Fixed legacy ports; no relocatable BARs.

_PROVISIONAL SCSI (SPEC-SCSIH-001 Sec 10). QLogic ISP1040 SCSI HBA, KZPBA lineage -- the canonical Alpha HBA. Named storage controller: scsi_disk/scsi_cdrom/scsi_tape targets addressed by (channel,unit,lun) where unit=SCSI target id. Bus facts (initiator_id/width) live in channels[]; channels:1 bounds channels[].index. Identity + BARs estimated; verify vs HRM/REFERENCE_INDEX and v5 (emulator SCSI type + S2 BAR rebind still pending).
_PROVISIONAL SCSI (SPEC-SCSIH-001 Sec 10). Symbios/NCR 53C810, KZPAA lineage; narrow bus. Identity estimated; verify before landing.
